extensions.name: ADAttributeHound
extensions.description: Exports selected Active Directory custom attributes as OpenGraph node properties so BloodHound can enrich or create nodes with additional directory context.

extensions.name: ConfigManBearPig
extensions.description: Adds Microsoft Configuration Manager and SCCM attack-path data to BloodHound through a PowerShell OpenGraph collector.

extensions.name: EntraAuthPolicyHound
extensions.description: Demonstrates collection of Entra ID permissions related to Temporary Access Passes and passkeys, then exports the results as BloodHound OpenGraph data.

extensions.name: EntraSSSOHound
extensions.description: Models Entra ID Seamless SSO trust paths that can allow Active Directory computers to affect synced Entra ID users.

extensions.name: ExchangeHound
extensions.description: Models Exchange on-premises objects and relationships, including mailbox delegation, folder access, transport rules, and Exchange RBAC assignments.

extensions.name: GhostHound
extensions.description: Enumerates Active Directory tombstones and reanimation rights, then emits OpenGraph data that highlights deleted-object restoration attack paths.

extensions.name: ManagerOfHound
extensions.description: Collects manager-subordinate relationships from Active Directory and exports them as custom ManagerOf edges for BloodHound ingestion.

extensions.name: MSSQLHound
extensions.description: Collects BloodHound OpenGraph-compatible data from one or more MSSQL servers and packages the output for ingestion.

extensions.name: PrivHound
extensions.description: Models Windows local privilege escalation vectors as multi-hop attack paths that can overlay existing SharpHound Active Directory data.

extensions.name: ProfileHound
extensions.description: Finds user profiles on domain machines and creates HasUserProfile edges that help operators decide which systems to target for credential access.

extensions.name: SCCM_SQL_Collector
extensions.description: Collects SCCM attack paths from an SCCM site database using a proof-of-concept SQL collection workflow.

extensions.name: SCOMHound
extensions.description: Enumerates System Center Operations Manager infrastructure from Active Directory and emits BloodHound OpenGraph data.

extensions.name: ShareHound
extensions.description: Maps network shares, permissions, and paths at scale to help identify attack paths to network shares.

extensions.name: TaskHound
extensions.description: Hunts for Windows scheduled tasks that run with privileged accounts and stored credentials, then exports findings for BloodHound.

extensions.name: WinSSHound
extensions.description: Maps lateral movement paths through misconfigured native and third-party SSH servers in Active Directory environments.
